nodes.title: How is one process's cost divided among several outputs?
nodes.summary: It is not divided. Every co-product carries the whole process cost against its own output mass. No basis, no routing model, no boundary to choose

nodes.title: Why will this not die the way local currencies died?
nodes.summary: Three failures. Circulation cannot occur — there is no medium of exchange. Institutional suppression does not fit an accounting system. Valuation is only partly answered (OP-16)

nodes.title: Is in-kind calculation computationally possible at national scale?
nodes.summary: Yes, demonstrated. Cockshott & Cottrell with sparse-matrix methods. Mises's objection was in-principle; the scale objection was answered by people who ran the arithmetic

nodes.title: Does Steedman's negative-value result apply?
nodes.summary: No. Nothing is divided and nothing is inverted, so there is no share that could be negative. The withdrawn division was also confirmed non-negative across 4,098 economies, and the result survives a fortiori now that no division is performed

nodes.title: Can identical twins share one account?
nodes.summary: The arithmetic refuses it. IC-7 caps an account at 24 h in 24 h, so two twins faking one account reach 34 hours a day against 36 honest — they lose 730 hours a year and gain nothing

nodes.title: Who owns land?
nodes.summary: Nobody. A structure occupies a bounded space, and that occupation is a remediation debt discharged only by actually restoring the space

nodes.title: How does someone use Aequitas while the world still uses money?
nodes.summary: Both directions permitted, both dearer than trading inside. Money is invisible because it is not physical, so a payment is not an event. Goods cross the boundary; standing does not — you cannot buy hours

nodes.title: Is a first estimate being wrong a problem?
nodes.summary: No inaccuracy in this system is irreversible. Every figure is a dated reading, and better science re-weights every affected ledger backwards through history

nodes.title: Does re-weighting make past purchases retroactively illegal?
nodes.summary: No. `D ≤ ρ·(C + P)` is evaluated at the moment of the transaction. A revision changes what a person may carry in future and never invalidates a completed act

nodes.title: Does the system need to record everything a person does?
nodes.summary: No, and attempting it would be "futile and grotesque." The accounting covers what is claimed and attested. What a network owes is to say in advance what it does cover

nodes.title: Who gets the last scarce item?
nodes.summary: Deliberately not settled here. A queue, a lottery, or pledge-priority, decided where the physical thing is handed over. Cost says what a thing took; distribution is a separate question

nodes.title: Then do the books inflate, if two products both carry 100 MJ?
nodes.summary: No. A3: a debit is a unique record of one specific event — a pointer at an identified parcel, not an amount. Both point at the same 100 MJ. The ledger walk is a union over parcels, never a sum

nodes.title: How big is a trust network?
nodes.summary: No set size. One valley, one trade, one country, or the world. A8 is about who may change the rules, not about how big anyone is

nodes.title: Does reading a chain more finely change the figures?
nodes.summary: Yes, one way only. A coarse reading is a ceiling on a fine reading — a product carries the steps it passed through ÷ its own mass, and those steps are a subset. A producer wanting a lower figure must buy more measurement

nodes.title: Where does the basic-needs floor come from? Is it a grant?
nodes.summary: It is not an income, a benefit, a safety net or an entitlement. Keeping a living human body alive is work, so it credits at the ordinary rate. Credit for no time worked is the abstract issued quantity A1 forbids

nodes.title: What stops inequality?
nodes.summary: `24 ÷ F` inside one network's books, and it is an absolute maximum nobody reaches. A very hard working life reaches about 1.6×, not 2.4×. Money reaches ~10⁶×

nodes.title: Who funds the auditors?
nodes.summary: Nobody. "Funding" imports a question from money that does not survive translation. Audit work is work, recorded when it happens. What is scarce is demand and verification, not the credit

nodes.title: What stops a lax network exporting inflated credit?
nodes.summary: A counterparty re-computes the claim through its own model and discounts it. ⚠️ That guard depends on OP-22 and the mechanism does not exist yet

nodes.title: Whose are a power station's emissions?
nodes.summary: The generating company's. It bought the fuel, held it and burned it, so the emission is its members' debit, divided by hours worked. A kilowatt-hour carries only the labour and materials the plant consumed; the household never held the fuel. Transmission losses stay with the generator

nodes.title: What happens on death?
nodes.summary: The record closes and persists. Credit does not transfer and nothing is inherited on the credit side. Material debit moves with the things; consumption and pollution debit does not move

nodes.title: Cost, not price
nodes.summary: A thing's cost is the current best estimate of what was consumed to make it; nothing is added and nothing enters that the thing did not consume, so there is no profit in exchange.

nodes.title: Derived ledger
nodes.summary: An account's standing is never stored; it is computed on demand from the append-only event log under the current weighting model, and the log alone is authoritative.

nodes.title: Material flow value
nodes.summary: Every debit records a real material or energy flow and every credit records time a person spent; no abstract or issued quantity exists anywhere in the system.

nodes.title: No externalities
nodes.summary: Every consequence of an activity stays inside the accounting and is assigned to whoever caused it, or held explicitly unassigned until an attribution witness exists.

nodes.title: Non-fungibility
nodes.summary: Every credit and debit is a unique record of one event; credit cannot be transferred, lent or traded, and only debit moves, attached to a thing.

nodes.title: Protocol governance
nodes.summary: No organisation may acquire authority over the axioms or the conformance requirements; everything below them may vary from one trust network to the next and must be published.

nodes.title: Statistical coverage
nodes.summary: Every human is in the books whether or not they take part; an estimated position becomes usable only with a verified account and observed records that replace the estimates.

nodes.title: Time as yardstick
nodes.summary: Time is a yardstick for summarising flows, not a value in itself, so labour is never rate-scaled and one hour credits as one hour.

nodes.title: C10 (cross-level trade)
nodes.summary: OP-7; deferred to v2.

nodes.title: C12 (energetics registry)
nodes.summary: Per-process data + rival-audit rules; home of OP-24.

nodes.title: Capitalism cannot function
nodes.summary: With no profit in exchange, no income from holding, no gain from working on your own property and no transferable credit, rent, interest, speculation and compounding capital have no mechanism to exist; markets and competition on quality survive.

nodes.title: Disparity ceiling
nodes.summary: Inside one network's books the largest and smallest lifetime pledge budget per day lived differ by at most 24 ÷ F; it bounds the say over what gets made, not consumption, and nobody reaches it.

nodes.title: Honest advantage
nodes.summary: The main defence against cheating is that honest participation returns more than cheating, because fraud cannot compound or transfer and its upside is bounded.

nodes.title: No taxation
nodes.summary: Civil servants are credited directly and infrastructure users carry debit by use, so there is nothing to collect and nothing to fund.

nodes.title: Regulator inversion
nodes.summary: An environmental regulator becomes a service businesses want, because helping a producer lower its debit lowers its products' cost; enforcement turns into consulting.

nodes.title: IC-1 (mass balance)
nodes.summary: Σ input mass = Σ output mass.

nodes.title: IC-10 (non-negative allocation)
nodes.summary: No output's share of any dimension is negative.

nodes.title: IC-11 (exhaustive allocation)
nodes.summary: Per dimension, shares sum to the recorded input total.

nodes.title: IC-12 (boundary additivity)
nodes.summary: Stage-by-stage split = whole-process split (anti-gerrymandering).

nodes.title: IC-2 (energy balance)
nodes.summary: Σ input energy = Σ output + declared dissipation.

nodes.title: IC-3 (origin closure)
nodes.summary: Every parcel traces to a reservoir extraction or a genesis terminus.

nodes.title: IC-4 (fate closure)
nodes.summary: Every parcel is held, consumed, or released; else *unaccounted*.

nodes.title: IC-5 (custody continuity)
nodes.summary: One holder at any instant; every hand-off is an event.

nodes.title: IC-6 (interval sanity)
nodes.summary: No consuming a parcel before it exists or after it's destroyed.

nodes.title: IC-7 (24-hour cap)
nodes.summary: Agent-time can't exceed wall-clock; ≤24h credited per 24h.

nodes.title: IC-8 (pledges drawn from credit)
nodes.summary: Cumulative pledged hours ≤ lifetime earned credit (no fractional reserve). The budget is spent at pledge time and never returned.

nodes.title: IC-9 (pledge discharge)
nodes.summary: On occurrence, a held object's debit follows possession to whoever accepts it (not necessarily the pledger); a pure service moves none. Pledges are permanent and non-revocable (§4.6); an unfulfilled pledge burns, it is not returned.

nodes.title: Components C1 to C12
nodes.summary: The twelve build items of the specification, from the event-log schema to the energetics registry, each with its current status and the wiki page that carries it.

nodes.title: Integrity constraints IC-1 to IC-12
nodes.summary: The twelve arithmetic checks a ledger must never violate, each a conformance row; nine check the log itself (mass and energy balance, origin and fate closure, one holder at a time, interval sanity, the 24-hour cap, pledges drawn from credit and no refund) and three check what any output carries (nothing negative, the union equals what went in, a coarser reading never lowers a figure).

nodes.title: Open problems OP-1 to OP-28
nodes.summary: Every open problem the project has registered, its current status, the mechanism it sits under, and the paper or register section that carries it; five are live and have their own node page, the rest are dissolved, closed, answered or stated-not-worked.

nodes.title: Calculation in kind (Neurath)
nodes.summary: Neurath's 1919 proposal to plan in physical units rather than money, and the Mises and Hayek calculation objection it provoked, which Aequitas answers by keeping cost and demand separate.

nodes.title: Cost the limit of price (Warren)
nodes.summary: Josiah Warren's 1827 Cincinnati Time Store sold at cost and was paid in labour hours; it worked and broke on skill and unpleasantness, the problem A2 and front-loaded training answer.

nodes.title: Ellerman's responsibility imputation
nodes.summary: A1's attribution rests on David Ellerman's labour theory of property, impute responsibility to whoever was in fact responsible, a juridical principle courts already use; it is chosen over any labour theory of value because it says only who did what, which is why credit cannot move, why machines and their owners get nothing, and why a cost never lands on a buyer who did not act.

nodes.title: Energy accounting (Technocracy Inc.)
nodes.summary: Technocracy Inc.'s non-transferable energy certificates, the nearest failed relative of Aequitas; it died as an organisation with a leader, which is the historical case for A8.

nodes.title: The field record
nodes.summary: A century of local currencies and time banks did not fail one way but three, by valuation, by circulation and by institution; Aequitas is immune to the circulation death by construction, has answered the institutional one with no issuer and no founder dependency, and has the valuation one partly answered with onerousness still open.

nodes.title: Markets vs antimarkets (DeLanda)
nodes.summary: DeLanda's reading of Braudel: markets of small price-takers and antimarkets of large price-setters are different things, and Aequitas targets only the second.

nodes.title: Mutualism (Proudhon)
nodes.summary: Proudhon's exchange at cost and interest-free mutual credit; Aequitas keeps the diagnosis of rent and interest as extraction and rejects the monetary remedy.

nodes.title: Post-scarcity (Saadia)
nodes.summary: Manu Saadia's reading of Star Trek as post-scarcity by organisational choice; useful for making the goal vivid, never as evidence that a mechanism works.

nodes.title: The books never balance
nodes.summary: Total debit exceeds total credit permanently, because every real process wastes something; no mechanism may require global balance, sums are meaningless, and two separate numbers matter instead, a person's ratio of debit to credit and their absolute credit.

nodes.title: Co-product allocation
nodes.summary: A joint process's cost is not divided; every co-product carries the whole cost of the steps it passed through against its own mass, a ledger walk unions parcels rather than summing them, and a finer reading can only lower a figure.

nodes.title: Consumption debit
nodes.summary: Debit for matter or energy used up, burned or released; it stays permanently on whoever caused it, never moves with a thing, and its weight floats with the current cost of remediation.

nodes.title: Debit taxonomy
nodes.summary: The map of every kind of debit, property debit with its three components, consumption and pollution debit that never moves, the vector rule, the self-work identity, non-cascade, and the front-loading rule.

nodes.title: Debit tolerance
nodes.summary: The consumption gate D ≤ ρ·(C + P), its two dials the floor F and the tolerance ρ, why the floor is credit for lived time rather than an allowance, and the measured band inside which both work.

nodes.title: Debit is a vector
nodes.summary: A debit is stored as a bundle of physical quantities, never as one number; it is collapsed into hours only when somebody asks, and any division of a debit happens on each quantity separately, before collapsing, so the split never depends on the weighting model.

nodes.title: How a dispute resolves
nodes.summary: Disputes about the physical record, the weighting model and an estimate need no verdict, because each party recomputes the shared record under its own model; only fraud needs a finding of fact, and correction negates the fake credit without reversing any transaction.

nodes.title: Distributed auditing
nodes.summary: Auditing is credited work done by competing trust networks rather than an appointed authority; the cheapest checks are pure arithmetic on the log and need no trust at all.

nodes.title: A durable asset is shared by holding time
nodes.summary: A building, plant or tool holds its creation cost as debit on the asset itself; each holder's permanent share is their holding time divided by the total holding time over the asset's life, so a new hire bears almost nothing, a carrier in transit takes no share, and the share dilutes but never reaches zero after a hand-off.

nodes.title: Education as credited work
nodes.summary: Students are credited for learning and teachers for teaching; the cost of training is carried during the training years, cushioned by pledges, and never charged to whoever uses the skill later.

nodes.title: End-of-life debit
nodes.summary: An object nobody will take on has been consumed by its last holder, who carries its end-of-life debit permanently; a discarded object is itself a pollutant for as long as it persists; recycled material carries its property debit forward but never the original producer's process pollution.

nodes.title: Enrichment
nodes.summary: Enrichment is work in which knowledge, skill or culture reaches somebody; it is one of three names that decide whether an hour is creditable, it credits one hour for one hour, and it is verified by evidence the work happened, never by how many people liked it, because feedback is not credit.

nodes.title: Estimation engine
nodes.summary: How a consumption basket is turned into labour, energy, materials and pollution through the whole supply chain, where the data comes from, and the rule that the leftover R = N − Y is published whole and divided by nothing.

nodes.title: Event record
nodes.summary: The only thing written to the log is an event, matter and energy moving between parcels, reservoirs and accounts, with no price, weight or value field, so cost is computed at projection time and conservation is an arithmetic check.

nodes.title: The published evidence rule
nodes.summary: A trust network publishes, for every kind of work it credits, what evidence that work requires, before crediting any of it; it credits no kind of work it has no rule for; and it never converts another network's figures into its own, only re-computes the claim from the shared physical record.

nodes.title: The front-loading rule
nodes.summary: A large up-front cost with a diffuse benefit is carried where it is incurred, cushioned at that time by the backing of the people who pledged for it, and never charged onward to whoever happens to consume the result; it covers education, media, research, infrastructure, tooling and capital, and a durable asset's cost is shared among its holders by holding time.

nodes.title: Land is not owned
nodes.summary: Land cannot be owned; a building occupies a bounded space relative to the Earth, and that occupation is a remediation debt on the structure's holders, the cost of restoring the space to its natural state, cleared only by actually remediating it; the holder bears only what they themselves effected.

nodes.title: Ledger ecosystem
nodes.summary: There is no single Aequitas database; many trust networks keep their own books, compare but never convert each other's figures, and are expected to federate and merge over time.

nodes.title: Lifetime reconstruction
nodes.summary: When a person joins, their position is rebuilt back to their birth on both sides, credit and debit; the estimate is the default and evidence is voluntary, an undisclosed period is estimated over the undisclosed leftover and errs against the person, the declared span is set back to the earliest date the evidence allows, and for a median person joining is a windfall.

nodes.title: Meme tracing
nodes.summary: Ideas are traced as they spread so originators are recognised without anyone being excluded from using them; the recognition is feedback and never credit.

nodes.title: Networks federate by agreeing methods, not answers
nodes.summary: Two networks never negotiate a person's balance; merging means agreeing every rule, after which one answer is computed from one log, and until then each keeps its own book; goods cross the money boundary in both directions at a deliberate cost, standing never does, and extraction exhausts itself through the extractor's own gate.

nodes.title: Onboarding incentive
nodes.summary: Joining replaces an assigned cohort estimate with a real record; most people's footprint is below their cohort average and their estimated credit is unusable until they join, so joining pays.

nodes.title: One person, one account
nodes.summary: Inside one trust network a verified human holds exactly one account; participation is voluntary but coverage is not, so a non-participant is estimated on both sides and can neither draw on that estimate nor be charged for it; one person may hold accounts with two networks, and the two are never added.

nodes.title: An organisation's debit is its members' debit
nodes.summary: An organisation's account is a view of its members' positions, not an owner of them; every debit its members caused while acting for it is their own debit, divided by the hours each worked, so closing the organisation moves nothing and a chain of shells escapes nothing.

nodes.title: Permanence, and what happens at death
nodes.summary: Once records of a person exist they are never destroyed, only added to, including after death; you can stop transacting but you cannot be erased, and consumption debit stays with its causer for good.

nodes.title: Physical-trace test
nodes.summary: Before dividing a cost, ask whether the thing divided left a physical trace; measure it if so, declare a convention and say so if not, and refuse to divide where nothing was divided in the world.

nodes.title: Pledge and signal
nodes.summary: A pledge is permanent backing of a named person, drawn one for one from the pledger's earned credit and spent once from a lifetime budget; a signal is a free statement of wanting; together they are the demand side with no price and no planner.

nodes.title: Pollution from making stays with the maker
nodes.summary: Pollution caused by making a thing stays permanently with the maker and never reaches a buyer; pollution caused by using a thing belongs to whoever used it; a thing that will pollute when used carries that future pollution in physical units, and it moves with the thing until somebody uses it.

nodes.title: Privacy is a network choice
nodes.summary: Market data is public and personal ledgers are private; how private is each trust network's own setting, opacity is discounted rather than forbidden, and the minimum an auditor must see is the unsolved OP-22.

nodes.title: Production
nodes.summary: Production is one of the three names (production, service, enrichment) that decide whether an hour is creditable, never how much it credits; there is one credit, time spent, and a made thing's hours start counting when the thing changes hands.

nodes.title: Property debit
nodes.summary: The debit of a thing you hold; its material moves with the thing, your share of its making hours is set by how long you held it and stays with you, and a durable asset's whole creation cost sits on its holders, never in what it made.

nodes.title: A network publishes its own workings
nodes.summary: A network asks people to rely on its arithmetic, so it publishes every estimating number, every method, and anonymised data covering all its participants; funding is only the recognition of an activity as creditable; a network's own founding is recorded like any pre-existing thing; and publishing more to earn trust also publishes more to identify people by.

nodes.title: A record beats an estimate
nodes.summary: A record comes from an observation or attestation and an estimate from a published method; a record replaces an estimate and never the reverse; no record is ever deleted or edited, only annotated or superseded beside the original; and a network publishes, before anyone joins, how a correction is asked for.

nodes.title: Retroactive re-weighting
nodes.summary: When a cost constant improves, every record computed from it recalculates backwards through history; a pollutant's weight floats with the ambient stock, and the gate is evaluated at transaction time so no revision reopens a completed act.

nodes.title: Rival-sector audit (withdrawn)
nodes.summary: The withdrawn proposal that a rival sector would fund the replication of an understated cost constant; it fails because rivals gain more from their own generous constant, so understatement drift stays open as OP-24.

nodes.title: Self-work identity
nodes.summary: Work on a thing you hold credits you the hours and raises the thing's debit by the same hours, so the net is zero apart from the materials and energy consumed.

nodes.title: Service
nodes.summary: A service is work done for a person, an organisation or oneself, often with nothing to hand over; it credits one hour for one hour like any other work, the check is the client's confirmation, and keeping yourself alive is a service a network may recognise.

nodes.title: Trust network
nodes.summary: A trust network is the organisation that keeps the books, records material flows, checks the arithmetic, estimates what it cannot see, and publishes its methods; it has no set size, keeps its own books that are never added to another network's, and does eight jobs in order.

nodes.title: The unassigned residual
nodes.summary: A network says how much of a region's output it did not see as one subtraction, R = N − Y, computed and published whole; the leftover is debit on no account, it is never divided by a count of producers, a figure built from two incomplete readings carries a floor, ceiling or not-identified label, and the outside total must be a physical measurement.

nodes.title: Verification ladder
nodes.summary: Four rungs for establishing that a recorded event happened, from people vouching to instruments to machine tallying; every rung reads every other, checking gets cheaper per unit as you climb, and trust moves to the instrument rather than disappearing.

nodes.title: P4
nodes.summary: The extractive employer is structurally foreclosed. Coordination power is not

nodes.title: OP-1 (service → influence)
nodes.summary: How service work converts to influence without becoming a currency.

nodes.title: OP-10 — weighting governance
nodes.summary: Whoever sets the weighting model, what a kilogram, a joule or a tonne of CO₂ costs in hours, influences every ledger in history without touching a core rule; one side entrance is closed, cost constants have published requirements, and the general question of who governs the method set is open and is the top blocking problem.

nodes.title: OP-11 (training amortization)
nodes.summary: Choosing a training-cost denominator.

nodes.title: OP-14 (cohort shopping)
nodes.summary: Joiners self-identify into a favourable cohort / floor.

nodes.title: OP-15 (ghost harvesting)
nodes.summary: Estimated credit accrues to non-joiners and the dead.

nodes.title: OP-16 — the onerousness gap
nodes.summary: Exertion, hazard and skill resolve as material costs, but tedium and indignity leave no physical trace and no causal tail, so two jobs with identical calories, training and health outcomes credit identically while nobody wants one of them; a pledge can now name whoever does the dull job, and whether enough people pledge for dull work is unmeasured.

nodes.title: OP-18 (labour & team credit)
nodes.summary: Responsibility/labour split across co-products and teams.
nodes.status: ✅ Closed (B9). The co-product half dissolved 2026-09-03: labour is not split across outputs either, so the OP-18(α) convention is withdrawn. The team half stands

nodes.title: OP-20 (unobservable work)
nodes.summary: Crediting work that leaves no trace.

nodes.title: OP-21 (media reproduction)
nodes.summary: Charging for infinitely-copyable media.

nodes.title: OP-22 — minimum audit disclosure
nodes.summary: What is the least an auditor must see to check a claim without seeing a person's history; the shape is a proof that reveals nothing but the answer, who decides is settled (the trust network), the disclosure set itself does not exist yet, and the lifetime reconstruction makes a person's record a dossier the incentive runs toward assembling.

nodes.title: OP-24 — understatement drift
nodes.summary: A cost constant that overstates a debit is corrected by everyone paying it, and one that understates a debit is corrected by nobody, so the books drift toward under-costing with no equation breaking; the rival-sector fix was withdrawn, auditing constants is a trust-network design problem held to five published requirements, and no network has shown a working answer.

nodes.title: OP-25 (illicit dumping)
nodes.summary: Abandonment/end-of-life attribution.

nodes.title: OP-28 — the residual denominator
nodes.summary: The leftover R = N − Y used to be divided by a head count of unmeasured producers, where the physical-trace test demands a measurement; the division was withdrawn after two worlds differing by 1.21× handed one network identical books, and what remains open is the extent register the production model distributes by, which a producer declaring half their land defeats and which no survey has been shown to catch.

nodes.title: OP-3 (estimation convergence)
nodes.summary: Does estimation converge from cohort average to individual truth? (C3)

nodes.title: OP-4 — the debit-tolerance formula
nodes.summary: The floor F and the tolerance ρ are each network's settings with a bound at each end; the band inside which essentials stay affordable and the gate still rations was measured and never closes between 1 and 14 hours a day, but the formula was not derived, the band's upper edge halves under full pledging, and whether a network credits a child's learning time is a second dial on the same ceiling.

nodes.title: OP-5 (education cost)
nodes.summary: Perpetual-studenthood exploit.

nodes.title: OP-6 (feedback mechanics)
nodes.summary: Feedback aggregation + signal flooding.

nodes.title: OP-7 (cross-level trade)
nodes.summary: Fairness of trade across verification levels.

nodes.title: OP-9 (calculation reply)
nodes.summary: Preference revelation / the Mises–Hayek critique (= P5).

nodes.title: The "natural state" baseline
nodes.summary: What the natural state of an already-urban plot is

nodes.title: Whether a network can be trusted with what it holds
nodes.summary: A network keeping lifetime reconstructions holds a concentration of information comparable to the concentration of wealth this project removes

nodes.title: Can feedback be bought?
nodes.summary: A purchasable signal is a back-door currency

nodes.title: Minimise data. Record less. Let people delete records
nodes.summary: Coverage is not voluntary. Every human is in the books whether they take part or not, and *"a log that can be truncated is not a log."* Participation is the dial. Coverage is not

nodes.title: Assume a parcel's identity, or treat an unresolvable one as unknowable
nodes.summary: Identity is created by an event. A mix records a new parcel pointing back at its inputs; a split records a child pointing back at its parent. A parcel with no such event has no beginning and is reported under row 7. And a split divides by mass per dimension, while a joint process divides nothing

nodes.title: Add up what several co-products carry, to get the process total
nodes.summary: A debit is a unique record, not an amount. A parcel reached by two paths is counted once. Summing overstates a real refinery by 7.00× and gives a different answer at every level of detail

nodes.title: Amortise a barn, a hospital or a machine into the price of each unit it made
nodes.summary: The beef did not build the barn. Charging onward never terminates — it chases the builder, the steelmaker, the doctors' education, back to the first human activity

nodes.title: Charge the buyer for the pollution of making the thing
nodes.summary: Only the miner acted to pollute. Pollution from *making* stays with the maker permanently; pollution from *using* belongs to the user

nodes.title: Charge a patient for the doctor's training
nodes.summary: Training is paid when it happens. A large up-front cost with a diffuse benefit is carried where it is incurred, never charged onward

nodes.title: Divide the leftover `R = N − Y` among the producers you know are missing
nodes.summary: Measured, not argued. Two different worlds give one network identical books to the last decimal, so no rule computed from them can separate the two. A residual proves activity is missing; it does not prove whose

nodes.title: Require the books to balance
nodes.summary: Aggregate debit exceeds aggregate credit permanently and by construction. That is the second law of thermodynamics appearing in the ledger

nodes.title: Record a share, a bond, a currency or a token
nodes.summary: Not matter and not energy. What is recorded is the material the claim is upon, sitting on whoever physically holds or operates it

nodes.title: Make someone accept an object they do not want
nodes.summary: *Custody follows possession* means you cannot take a thing and disclaim its debit. It does not mean anyone can be forced to take a thing

nodes.title: Reverse a fraudulent past transaction
nodes.summary: You cannot un-eat a sandwich. The fake credit is negated, the ratio fails, and discretionary purchases stop. Unwinding it would corrupt the honest seller's books

nodes.title: Erase a person's record on request
nodes.summary: There is entry and there is no exit. Ceasing to participate is always available; erasure never is. Re-weighting and lifetime reconstruction are both impossible over deleted records

nodes.title: Add bankruptcy, or forgive accumulated debit
nodes.summary: There is time. Everyone alive accrues credit at the floor, so the ratio recovers on its own. The consequence is exactly the size of the fraud, measured in time, and nobody sets it

nodes.title: Attribute an electricity emission by a supply contract
nodes.summary: An agreement is a paper claim. A record of CO₂ must come from a measurement of CO₂ — and the emission is the generating company's, which held the fuel and burned it. No emission reaches a consumer who never held the fuel

nodes.title: Let a network declare loyalty to itself creditable
nodes.summary: Loyalty is not production, not a service, and not enrichment. The three categories are the outer wall and they do not vary

nodes.title: Add a rule, an exception or a special case for an awkward profession or sector
nodes.summary: Universality. *"A system with exceptions cannot be shown to be wrong. Any awkward case gets a new exception"*

nodes.title: Pay more per hour for skilled, dangerous or unpleasant work
nodes.summary: Labour is never rate-scaled. One hour credits as one hour. The three real differences land as material costs — extra food, injected harm-debit, front-loaded training

nodes.title: Let likes, citations, reviews or applause create credit
nodes.summary: Forbidden by name. Verification asks whether the work happened, never whether anyone valued it. Feedback is not credit

nodes.title: Transfer, lend, gift, gamble or inherit credit
nodes.summary: A credit records who was responsible. Responsibility is a fact about a person, so there is nothing coherent to transfer

nodes.title: Convert one network's credit into another's
nodes.summary: Comparison, never conversion. A rate between two credit-standards is a medium of exchange, and A3 forbids one

nodes.title: Set a global value for ρ, `F`, or the privacy practice
nodes.summary: No organisation may acquire authority over the core rules. These are network dials, published and competed on

nodes.title: Make a joint process's cost depend on what people want, or on which cut is desirable
nodes.summary: Two identical steers in two towns would carry different figures. Fails universality, and it is price allocation in costume. *(Yield left this ban on 2026-09-03: output mass is physical and a scale reads it — see §2)*

nodes.title: Divide a joint process's cost among its outputs at all
nodes.summary: 36 methods that all satisfied the four obligations came out 6.31× apart. The division was withdrawn rather than governed. Where nothing was divided in the world, refuse to divide it in the books
